plugin.note: Protect from Magic is highly recommended. Slash severs the Aquanite lure and reduces stab Defence from 60 to 10, so open with a slash attack (Abyssal whip, a scimitar, Saradomin godsword special or a weapon set to slash), then use the best stab melee setup. Ranged is a wiki-listed alternative and can be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range. Elder aquanites require Protect from Magic flicking to avoid their special, which hits up to 50.

requirements: 78 Slayer is required to kill Aquanites.
73 Sailing is required to moor at Ynysdail; the first trip needs a boat with an adamant keel or better.
The Lured In Slayer reward unlock is required before Nieve or Duradel can assign Aquanites; Mortimer assigns them without it.

50 Construction plus hammer, saw, 10 swamp paste, and 8 camphor planks are required to construct the Ynysdail rowboat for later travel (the Slayer task page states 70; the Rowboat amenity recipe states 50).
Using the rowboat between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith requires Song of the Elves.
mechanics: Aquanites attack with Magic and have high accuracy.
Protect from Magic is highly recommended against normal Aquanites.
A Dwarf multicannon cannot be placed because the ground is too damp.
Aquanites can be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
A slash attack severs the Aquanite lure and reduces stab Defence by 50, from 60 to 10.
Damage is not required to sever the lure, but the attack option must be set to slash.
A fast 4-tick slash weapon such as a scimitar or Abyssal whip is recommended for severing; a two-style weapon such as the Ghrazi rapier can swap between slash and stab instead.
Voidwaker special attack does not sever the lure because it is Magic-based, but regular Voidwaker slash attacks can sever it.
Burning claws and Arkan blade burn damage should only be applied after the lure is severed, otherwise the burn is nulled when the lure is cut.

Elder aquanites spawn at 1/200 on task after Bigger and Badder (1/150 with the elite Combat Achievements); their special disables protection prayers and hits up to 50 if Protect from Magic has been active for some time.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use Protect from Magic, sever the Aquanite lure with slash, then kill with high-damage melee, usually stab-focused after the defence reduction; ranged is the alternative.
prayers: Piety for melee, Rigour or Deadeye for ranged
steps: Enter Ynysdail Cavern and keep Protect from Magic active against normal Aquanites.
Open by landing any slash attack to sever the Aquanite lure.
After the lure is severed, switch to the strongest available stab or high-DPS melee weapon.
Optional: bring a rune pouch with Nature and Fire runes for High Level Alchemy on alchable drops.
Optional: bring a Seed box for seed drops and a Reagent pouch for the common snape grass drops; without a Reagent pouch, Ranarr potion (unf) can be combined with snape grass drops.
risks: Do not rely on cannon because it cannot be placed in the cavern.
Elder aquanite special attacks punish leaving Protect from Magic active continuously.
notes: Recommended ranged skills are Ranged 80+ and Prayer 63 for Deadeye or 74 for Rigour.
Recommended melee skills are Attack 80+, Strength 80+, and Prayer 70 for Piety.

methods.label: Melee Slash/Stab
methods.summary: Use a slash attack to cut the lure, then stab or strong melee weapons to benefit from the reduced stab Defence.
recommendedFor: lower Attack players who benefit from reducing stab Defence
requiredOrKeyItems: Abyssal whip or another fast 4-tick slash weapon
steps: Start the kill with a slash attack to sever the lure.
If using Voidwaker, use its regular slash attack to sever; its Magic-based special attack will not sever the lure.
After severing, switch to the best stab or high-DPS melee weapon.
Apply Burning claws or Arkan blade burns only after severing the lure so the burn is not nulled by the lure cut.
Saradomin godsword special attack can sever the lure and restore Prayer points if no other special attack weapon is brought.
fallbacks: If no dedicated slash switch is available, use a scimitar or Abyssal whip, or set a two-style weapon to slash.
If no premium stab weapon is available, use the best available melee weapon after severing.
risks: Skipping the slash sever leaves much higher stab Defence and lowers accuracy.
Soulreaper axe users may need emergency food.
notes: Oathplate chest and legs are listed first only when using a Soulreaper axe or Scythe of Vitur.
Blade of Saeldor, Voidwaker and Noxious halberd should be used on the stab attack style after severing.
inventory: Emergency food for Elder aquanites or Soulreaper axe use
Rune pouch with Nature and Fire runes

methods.label: Range
methods.summary: Use Protect from Magic with the wiki Range setup: Toxic blowpipe or Twisted bow, then Bow of Faerdhinen, Zaryte crossbow or Crystal bow. Aquanites can also be safespotted with a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
recommendedFor: players with stronger ranged than melee gear
safespotting with a 9 or 10 tile attack range
steps: Keep Protect from Magic active against normal Aquanites.
Attack with the best available ranged weapon; the lure sever only lowers stab Defence, so no slash switch is needed.
Optionally attack from the wiki safespot tiles with a weapon that has a 9 or 10 tile attack range.
Flick Protect from Magic against Elder aquanites.
Optional: bring a rune pouch with runes for High Level Alchemy and Teleport to House.
risks: Aquanites have 100 ranged Defence, so ranged is generally slower than a severed-lure stab setup.
notes: Crystal helm, body and legs are listed only when using a Bow of Faerdhinen or Crystal bow.
A shield is only used with a one-handed weapon.
inventory: Rune pouch with Nature, Fire, Law and Dust runes

methods.label: Elder aquanite
methods.summary: Elder aquanites are superior spawns; flick Protect from Magic instead of leaving it on continuously to avoid their prayer-disabling special, which hits up to 50.
recommendedFor: superior spawns after Bigger and Badder
prayers: Flick Protect from Magic between attacks
steps: Recognize the Elder aquanite superior spawn (1/200 on task, 1/150 with the elite Combat Achievements).
Do not leave Protect from Magic active continuously.
Flick Protect from Magic on and off between the enemy's attacks.
Continue using the slash-to-stab melee approach; slash also severs the Elder aquanite's lure.
risks: The special attack disables protection prayers and hits up to 50 if Protect from Magic has been active for some time.
Normal attacks can hit up to 34.

methods.label: Getting to Ynysdail
methods.summary: Reach Ynysdail by Sailing with an adamant keel or better, then build the rowboat hotspot for easier future access from north of Gwenith.
requiredOrKeyItems: Boat with adamant keel or better
Song of the Elves for the Gwenith rowboat route
steps: For first access, sail manually to Ynysdail with an adamant keel or better, entering through the green portal east of Lledrith Island.
Build the rowboat hotspot on the island.
After building it, use rowboats between Ynysdail and north of Gwenith; teleport to Prifddinas and exit north to reach the mainland rowboat.
Complete Song of the Elves to use the Gwenith-side rowboat route.
Enter Ynysdail Cavern from the island to reach the Aquanites.
risks: Without the rowboat or a greater teleport focus on the ship, returning may require resetting the ship to a mooring point.
